title: Leslie Mooney fell in love with Cincinnati, now she's leading Blink
summary: On the Enquirer's 'That's So Cincinnati' podcast, BLINK vice president and executive director Leslie Mooney discusses her path to the role and what to expect at the fifth BLINK, Oct. 8-11, with more than 90 artists and a record number of women artists.

title: 5 things to do in Cincinnati in October
summary: Digest of five large October 2026 events: BLINK (Oct. 8-11, five zones, Ready. Set. BLINK! replacing the parade), the FotoFocus Biennial (74 exhibitions at 65 venues, free Biennial Pass), the inaugural Cincinnati Art Week (Oct. 3-10 in Over-the-Rhine), StartupCincy Week and a new MORTAR conference.

title: What is Cincinnati Art Week?
summary: Profile of the inaugural Cincinnati Art Week (Oct. 3-10) and its co-founders, with a preview of the Welcome Center hub at 1600 Race St., work by artists such as Mz. Icar and Chas Wiederhold, Jason Snell's NO GRID conversation series and the Art City beer at Esoteric Brewing.
